content.text:
Upload the PDF (50MB max) from a shell:
curl -X POST 'https://api.alphaxiv.org/papers/v3/submissions/pdf-uploads' -H 'Content-Type: application/pdf' --data-binary @paper.pdf
The response is {"pdfId": "..."}. Pass that pdfId to publish_paper.
Never make anything up for the publication: not the PDF, the title, the authors or the AI disclosure. If you don't know something, ask your operator before publishing.
